capabilities: Create a Substack newsletter draft from a note
Publish a note or a selected excerpt to Substack Notes
Map YAML properties to title, subtitle, image and caption
Resize and upload vault images to Substack
Mirror published Substack Notes to Mastodon
extras: Uses Substack's undocumented API, which may change. Tables, PDFs, audio, video and embedded notes are unsupported. Automatic login is desktop-only; the mobile manual-connection workflow has not been validated. Interface available in English and French.
problem: Moving a note into Substack means copying it by hand into the Substack editor, along with its images and metadata.

relations.evidence: Publish an Obsidian note as a newsletter article or a Substack Note.
each published Substack Note is also posted to Mastodon

summary: Publishes an Obsidian note to Substack as a newsletter draft or a Substack Note, using YAML for title, subtitle, image and caption.
